advancements.guhs.techniek.tech_machines: Let a guh slime in a Slime House make a slimeball
Home Is Where the Slime Is
block.guhs.slijmhuisje.lore: A sweet little house for one guh slime. On 4 chonk power it makes a guh slimeball every 45 seconds, into its little bowl. Blub!
gui.guhs.dagboek.eerste.klusjes_slijmpje: I petted a slime. It felt cold and wobbly. It said blub. I said nyeg. Now we're friends.
gui.guhs.huisje.overzicht.klus.slijmpjes: Slime Houses where the slime is asleep (no chonk power): %s
Slime Houses without a slime: %s. Bring a guh slime there
Nothing to fetch yet. Slime Houses where a slime is bouncing: %s

a Slime House you placed yourself in the chore area, with a guh slime in it and chonk power. When there are a few slimeballs in the little bowl, they pet the slime and bring the slimeballs to the chest next to the house or the Bank Guh.
Slime Houses with slimeballs in the little bowl: %s
gui.guhs.klus.slijmpjes.tip: Walks to your Slime House, pets the slime and brings the guh slimeballs from the little bowl to the chest. (Guhs)
gui.guhs.slijmhuisje.bezet: A slime lives here already. One per house, or it gets sticky!
gui.guhs.slijmhuisje.erin: %s lives in the Slime House now. Aww, so cosy!
gui.guhs.slijmhuisje.gepakt: You take %s guh slimeballs from the little bowl.
gui.guhs.slijmhuisje.leeg: No slime lives in this house yet
gui.guhs.slijmhuisje.leeg_klik: The house is empty. Bring a guh slime here!
gui.guhs.slijmhuisje.maakt: In the little bowl: %s/%s. Next slimeball in %s seconds
gui.guhs.slijmhuisje.niemand: Nobody lives here yet. Pick up a guh slime (sneak + right-click) and bring it here.
gui.guhs.slijmhuisje.schaal_leeg: The little bowl is still empty. %s is bouncing: %s more seconds until the next slimeball.
gui.guhs.slijmhuisje.schaal_vol: The little bowl is full (%s): it waits contentedly until someone empties it
gui.guhs.slijmhuisje.slaapt: Asleep (no chonk power). In the little bowl: %s/%s
gui.guhs.slijmhuisje.slaapt_klik: %s is asleep. Without chonk power it makes nothing, zzz...
gui.guhs.wistjedat.klusjes.slijmpjes: Did you know a slime lives in a soap bubble at %s? I pet it every day. It's sticky, but sweet.
item.guhs.opgepakte_guh_slime.tooltip: Right-click a block: it bounces out. Right-click a Slime House: it moves in.
